This is a rough, intimate play, set in a tiny seventy-seat storefront theater.
Washington and Brown are both believable as the sisters and committed Provo members; their mom, Deirdre, is a firebrand for the original IRA too, storing weapons in their home to deliver as needed.
"The Kelly Girls" is a powerhouse production marked by exquisitely talented actors, phenomenal direction and a text that will make you think.
Commanding performances by Amber Washington, Brittney Brown, and Ann Sheridan Smith make the Factory Theater’s world premiere production of “The Kelly Girls” a standout.

cn.t: Commanding performances anchor this thought-provoking world premiere about the Troubles in Belfast, bringing violent sectarian conflict down to a personal, microcosmic level that reveals the harsh realities behind revolutionary ideals.
